body: Hi Laura, hope the week is treating you well! The physio team went through the bandage stock yesterday and we are nearly out, so could you send 80 elastic crepe bandages 5 cm when you can. No rush, Friday is fine. Thanks a lot!

Morning! Quick one from the residence. One of our residents keeps asking and the local shop never has them... can you add 1 pack of hearing aid batteries to our next delivery? If you don't stock them just tell me and I'll look elsewhere. Cheers

hey there, sorry to bother on a sunday lol. our sports clinic is running a summer camp and the kids keep twisting ankles. please put us down for twenty elastic ankle supports size S, thanks so much and have a good rest of the weekend

lines.WA-0017-L1: twenty elastic ankle supports size S

body: Good afternoon. We have the annual deep clean of the pharmacy storeroom next week and the contractors asked us to provide protection. We need 19 disposable protective coveralls size L. Delivery to the usual address please. Kind regards, Marta

Hello! Hope all good on your side. With the new isolation room opening we need to restock respirators, so please send ten boxes of FFP3 masks without valve. Let me know the delivery date when you have it. Thanks!

lines.WA-0027-L1: ten boxes of FFP3 masks without valve

body: Hi, it's Pablo from the pharmacy. A couple of local clinics have been asking us for this and I promised I would check with you first. Could you get us 8 bottles of ultrasound gel 5 litre? Please add them to our next delivery, thanks

Hiya, the nurses have been using tape like crazy this month, honestly no idea where it all goes haha. Can you send 14 boxes of silk tape 2.5 cm please? Same as last time. Thank you and say hi to the warehouse guys

Hello again. The care staff prefer the smaller size for the new team members, so this time we would like eight boxes of vinyl gloves size S, powder free. Please confirm when it ships. Many thanks from all of us at the residence

lines.WA-0032-L1: eight boxes of vinyl gloves size S, powder free

body: Good morning, we are refurbishing the east wing of the residence and the architect suggested asking our usual suppliers first. Would you be able to supply fourteen stair lifts? I know it's not your usual thing, just let me know either way. Thanks

hi! nurse Ana here from the residence. the flu jabs campaign starts monday and we are short on needles, so please send a couple of boxes of hypodermic neddles 22G 30mm. thanks a million, you always save us

lines.WA-0046-L1: a couple of boxes of hypodermic neddles 22G 30mm

body: Hi, hope you are well. Our GP visits are moving in house from next month and every floor needs its own monitor. Please send 13 automatic upper arm blood pressure monitors. Invoice to the residence account as usual. Thanks, Jorge

lines.WA-0048-L1: 13 automatic upper arm blood pressure monitors

body: Hey Laura! Just back from holidays and the dressing cupboard looks sad. Can you send a couple of packs of sterile gauze swabs 7.5 x 7.5? No hurry, whenever the next van is coming our way. Thx

lines.WA-0053-L1: a couple of packs of sterile gauze swabs 7.5 x 7.5

body: Hello, clinic here. The podiatrist asked me to reorder the tubular bandage she uses for ankles and feet, she says it is size C and not the bigger one. So 12 rolls of tubular bandage size C please. Thank you, have a nice day

lines.WA-0066-L1: 12 rolls of tubular bandage size C

body: Morning, quick order from the residence. The doctor needs the big ones for wound irrigation, not the little ones we normally get, so please send two boxes of 20ml luer slip syringes. Thanks and talk soon

lines.WA-0071-L1: two boxes of 20ml luer slip syringes

body: Hi there! The kitchen and cleaning staff asked for proper face protection after the inspection last week. Could you send 7 face shield visors with the reusable frame? Thanks in advance, have a great day

lines.WA-0073-L1: 7 face shield visors with the reusable frame

body: Hello Laura, good news, the clinic opened two more consulting rooms and the doctors want their own kit in each. Please add 3 fingertip pulse oximeters for adults to this week's delivery. Cheers!

Good evening, sorry for the late message. The urology consultant reviewed our stock today and asked me to order 9 boxes of Foley catheters 14 Fr, the 2-way silicone coated ones. Delivery tomorrow if possible, otherwise Thursday is fine

Hi! Big disinfection campaign at the residence after the outbreak last month, management finally approved it. We need 40 jerrycans of 70% alcohol 5 litre. Please let me know if you can deliver it in one go or in two trips
hello, the blood test nurse is complaining we only have the thin ones left. please send 2 boxes of 20G x 40 mm hypodermic needles when you can. thank you and sorry for the short notice again

lines.WA-0099-L1: 2 boxes of 20G x 40 mm hypodermic needles

body: Hi Laura, how was the conference? Hope you got some rest after. On our side we need a couple of bags of gauze bandage rolls 10 cm for the treatment room. Same delivery address as always, thanks!

lines.WA-0101-L1: a couple of bags of gauze bandage rolls 10 cm

body: Hello hello. The care homes group decided every room gets its own small bottle for the hand hygiene audit, so we need 120 bottles of 96% alcohol 100 ml. I know it's a lot, let me know if you need to split it. Thanks!

Hi, good morning. Many of the new customers at the pharmacy need the smaller fit, so the order this time is a bit different: 200 adult incontinence briefs size S. Please deliver before the weekend if you can. Thank you

Hey! The residents loved the cream from last month but the big pump bottles keep disappearing from the rooms haha. So this time the small ones please, 13 tubes of moisturising cream 100ml. Thanks, Rosa

Morning! Our GP practice inside the residence is getting busier every week and we go through the couch paper so fast. Please send eight packs of examination couch paper rolls 60 cm. Thanks and have a good one

lines.WA-0120-L1: eight packs of examination couch paper rolls 60 cm

body: Hi! Winter is coming and the residents have cracked lips already with the heating on. Could you send 19 lip balms spf15, the libp balm sticks we had before? Thanks a lot and greetings to everyone there

lines.WA-0123-L1: 19 lip balms spf15, the libp balm sticks

body: Hello again, sorry for the second message today, forgot something earlier. Please also add a couple of packs of non-sterile gauze swabs 7.5 x 7.5 cm 12 ply to the order. The van can bring everything together. Thanks!

lines.WA-0127-L1: a couple of packs of non-sterile gauze swabs 7.5 x 7.5 cm 12 ply

body: Hi Laura, the number of diabetic residents went up a lot this year so insulin supplies are flying. Could you send 1000 pen needles 32G 6mm? Please check stock first and tell me if there is any delay. Thank you

Good morning, the health and safety audit at the clinic flagged that our eye wash points are expired. Please send 11 eye wsh bottles 500ml as soon as possible, we need them before the reinspection next Tuesday. Thanks

Hi team, small order today. The wound care nurse runs through irrigation like water lol. Please send 10 bottles of saline solution 0.9% 500 ml with the next delivery. Thank you, and thanks for the fast service last time
Hey, the clinic floors were just redone and the boss wants everyone using shoe covers in the treatment area from now on. Can you send 6 packs of blue disposable shoe covers? Cheers and thanks!

lines.WA-0133-L1: 6 packs of blue disposable shoe covers

body: Hello, hope you're well. The doctor did a few minor stitches this week and used up all the strips, so please send a couple of boxes of skin closure strips 6 x 75 mm. Thanks so much and talk soon

lines.WA-0139-L1: a couple of boxes of skin closure strips 6 x 75 mm

body: Hi, good afternoon. The staff doing long shifts in the isolation unit say the valve ones are much more comfortable to breathe in. Can you send 11 boxes of FFP3 masks with exhalation valve? Thanks for everything

lines.WA-0160-L1: 11 boxes of FFP3 masks with exhalation valve
